how: The owner: every Reach item purchasable with credits, as in the 2010 Armory; MCC keeps everything unlocked and untouched, and Project Noble's own Armory decides what the player may wear. The prices and rank gates are Halo: Reach's own, read from the Halo: Reach Editing Kit's ui/supply_depot.cookie_purchase_globals (each item's credit cost, its minimum rank as a grade and sub grade, the items it needs bought first, its default / auto-buy flags). Each priced family lines up one to one with the Armory's catalog botcore logged (maps/_looks/reach_armory.json "writes": per slot, family and variant the configuration bytes the game's own equip sets), so each item gets the exact bytes it puts on. Names: native/look_names.h (the Armory's own names, by table index). Made by tools/reach_prices.py; do not edit.
grades: 1 Recruit, 2 Private, 3 Corporal, 4 Sergeant, 5 Warrant Officer, 6 Captain, 7 Major, 8 Lt. Colonel, 9 Commander, 10 Colonel, 11 Brigadier, 12 General, 13 Field Marshal, 14 Hero, 15 Legend, 16 Mythic, 17 Noble, 18 Eclipse, 19 Nova, 20 Forerunner, 21 Reclaimer; sub 1 the rank, 2 its Grade 1, ...
